baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive construction links effective warning to following the reminder, fearing the Merciful in the unseen, and then receiving good news.
baseline_models.mechanism: Warning is not merely transmitted sound. It awakens caution in a recipient who actively follows a restoring reminder and lets reverent fear operate without visible compulsion; the same sequence then turns from danger to pardon and honorable recompense.

activation_trace.role: Warning literally awakens caution by announcing danger and initiates the response sequence.
Following as going after and taking guidance makes reception an active alignment rather than bare hearing.
The reminder literally makes an absent or forgotten matter present and supplies what is followed.
Fear joined with awe makes the warning inwardly consequential.
Mercy, tenderness, and beneficence identify the feared Lord as the source of care rather than arbitrary menace.
Concealment from sight locates the response beyond immediate visual proof or surveillance.
A joy-opening report reverses the warning's affect without canceling its seriousness.
Pardon covers the fault and protects its bearer from the fault's consequence.
Recompense gives the response a consequential return rather than leaving it as inward disposition alone.
Praiseworthy nobility makes the recompense honor-conferring as well as beneficial.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists the kind of person who accepts a warning and then promises that person pardon and reward.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a conversion mechanism: warning becomes effective through active remembrance and unsupervised awe, then changes register into protective pardon and honor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence اتبع الذكر ... بالغيب ... فبشره can be read as movement from a reminder-trace through what is absent from sight toward an anticipatory sign.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following can mean tracking an effect step by step, while remembrance restores an absent matter to presence. The recipient therefore treats the reminder as a trace of unseen reality, and the good news functions as an early sign by which that future begins to act in the present.

activation_trace.role: The alert supplies the initial indication of a danger not yet seen.
Stepwise pursuit of an effect turns following into evidential trace-tracking.
Recollection brings what is absent or forgotten back before the heart and furnishes the tracked trace.
What is screened from eyes is the domain through which the trace must be followed.
First signs and advance appearances make the announcement an anticipatory manifestation of its promised outcome.

changed_reading.before: Following the reminder means obeying an already understood message.
changed_reading.after: Following the reminder can also mean pursuing a present trace into an unseen consequence, with good news serving as that consequence's first arrival.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compact pairing وخشي الرحمن بالغيب joins awe, mercy, and hiddenness before naming forgiveness as the result.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fear of the Merciful is not a contradiction if awe is the inward restraint that persists when conduct is unseen. Mercy supplies the relational frame, while forgiveness is a protecting cover for one who does not use hiddenness as permission to become heedless.

activation_trace.role: Awe-filled fear supplies inward restraint and seriousness.
Tender mercy makes the restraint relational and hopeful rather than despairing.
Being hidden from eyes tests whether the inward relation remains operative without external enforcement.
A covering that protects gives mercy a concrete outcome while preserving the fact that there was exposure to consequence.

changed_reading.before: The person fears God despite not seeing Him or while unobserved.
changed_reading.after: The phrase describes hidden integrity: mercy evokes a durable awe in private, and forgiveness answers that vulnerable fidelity with protective covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The man from the city's farthest edge bodily enacts the focus recipient: purposeful movement leads to urging others to follow, explicit belief, and finally the exact outcome pair of forgiveness and being made honored. The focus traits therefore form a lived trajectory that moves from marginal distance into public witness and unseen vindication.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful movement toward a sought end gives physical and intentional force to the recipient's following.
The explicit call to go after the messengers externalizes the focus ayah's following.
Gentle direction to the true path identifies the followed messengers as guides rather than objects of mere social attachment.
Heart-settling assent makes the man's following an explicit inner commitment.
The narrative states the same pardon that the focus ayah announces and realizes its protective outcome.
Being placed among the honored concretizes the focus ayah's noble recompense as transformed status.

structural_cues: The sequence 36:20-27 moves from coming and following through belief to entry into the garden, forgiveness, and honor.
The focus ayah's second-person promise becomes the first-person testimony of a recipient who wishes his rejecting people could know the outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated roots and the ordered narrative; I infer that the man is an enacted instance of the focus recipient. A live alternative is that the story illustrates only one especially costly form of the broader recipient pattern.

changed_reading.before: The recipient is a general class defined by receptive inward traits.
changed_reading.after: The recipient is also narratively embodied as someone who crosses distance, follows publicly, calls others, and reaches the promised forgiveness and honor beyond his people's sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messengers are followed precisely because they request no wage from the hearers, while the focus ayah promises a noble wage to the one who follows. The economic direction reverses: true guidance does not extract payment from its recipient; God grants the recipient recompense, pardon, and honor.

activation_trace.role: The repeated imperative to follow establishes the same transaction-facing action as the focus ayah.
Requesting and seeking payment is explicitly negated, blocking extraction from those addressed.
Wage and recompense name what the messengers do not take, setting up the reversal toward the follower's divine reward.
Guidance by gentle direction separates the messengers' function from a paid self-serving exchange.
Pardon is the first divine return received by the follower rather than a fee paid by him.
Conferred honor completes the counter-payment as dignifying generosity.

structural_cues: The same أجر root is denied as a messenger's demand in 36:21 but promised to the responsive hearer in 36:11.
The narrative outcome in 36:27 supplies forgiveness and honor without any human patron paying the man.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated wage root with opposite participant roles; I infer a deliberate reversal from extracted fee to bestowed recompense. It remains possible that the two wage uses are parallel ethical claims without a designed exchange structure.

changed_reading.before: The noble reward is compensation added after the recipient responds.
changed_reading.after: The noble reward is a counter-wage: guidance charges the follower nothing, and the Merciful answers the follower's response by paying in pardon and honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the surah's close, remembrance is paired with recitation and its warning is directed to whoever is alive. This recasts the focus traits as manifestations of living responsiveness: following remembrance and fearing in the unseen are not arbitrary entry conditions but signs that warning can still awaken and move the hearer.

activation_trace.role: A reminder that makes a matter present identifies the focus object's communicative function at the surah's close.
Recitation and reading give the reminder a voiced, transmissible form.
The warning again awakens caution, directly reopening the focus ayah's selective-warning construction.
Being alive literally supplies the class capable of receiving the warning and functions as the surah's diagnosis of responsiveness.

structural_cues: The relative construction من اتبع in 36:11 is echoed by من كان حيا in 36:70.
Both constructions are governed by the warning root, while 36:69 immediately identifies the message as remembrance and recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the syntactic echo and adjacent roots; I infer that following and unseen awe disclose the kind of life to which warning speaks. A live alternative is that being alive is an independent metaphorical condition rather than a reformulation of the focus traits.

changed_reading.before: Warning succeeds only with a person who already has two qualifying traits.
changed_reading.after: The two traits diagnose living receptivity: warning addresses, reveals, and can further animate the hearer who is not inwardly dead.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus recipient follows a reminder as a trace, but the surah immediately says that deeds and their remaining traces are written and exhaustively counted, then depicts limbs testifying to what was earned. Following is therefore reciprocal: the person tracks the reminder into the unseen while the person's own movement leaves tracks that follow him into judgment.

activation_trace.role: Stepwise pursuit of traces anchors the model in the focus verb's investigative branch.
Recollection restores what is absent and gives the follower an orienting trace.
Writing and the written record preserve the follower's own acts beyond their moment.
A remaining mark that indicates what occurred turns consequences into legible tracks.
Exhaustive counting prevents any resulting trace from falling outside the account.
A witnessing sign makes embodied action disclose what its owner might no longer voice.
Acquired gain names the conduct to which bodily traces testify and connects action to recompense.

structural_cues: The ledger statement in 36:12 comes immediately after the focus ayah.
The later bodily testimony in 36:65 converts accumulated action into witnesses when ordinary speech is sealed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, recorded آثار, exhaustive counting, and bodily witness; I supply the reciprocal arrow that the trace-follower also becomes trace-bearing. Alternatively, the ledger may ground judgment without intentionally revising the semantics of following.

changed_reading.before: The recipient follows an external reminder toward an unseen result.
changed_reading.after: The recipient follows a trace while simultaneously producing enduring traces; unseen fidelity is both guided and made accountably legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: After presenting drowning with no rescuer, the surah makes mercy the sole exception and continued enjoyment only temporary; it then commands protective self-guarding so that mercy may be received. Fearing the Merciful in the unseen becomes vigilant use of a mercy-granted interval, not terror opposed to mercy.

activation_trace.role: Awe-filled fear is the focus response whose functional direction is revised by the context.
Literal drowning supplies the threatened exposure from which ordinary supports cannot save.
Rescue as extraction from peril is negated and clears the causal field for mercy as the exception.
Merciful beneficence explicitly supplies preservation where rescue was unavailable.
Extended enjoyment makes present survival a granted reprieve rather than self-secured permanence.
A bounded time gives the mercy-granted interval an endpoint and sustains warning within it.
Putting oneself under protection supplies the active response that links warning to possible mercy.
Receiving mercy is stated as the hoped-for result of protective vigilance.

structural_cues: The exception إلا رحمة in 36:44 directly follows the negation of rescue in 36:43.
The command اتقوا and result ترحمون occur together in 36:45, joining self-guarding to mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies peril, mercy as exception, temporary continuance, and the guarding-to-mercy sequence; I infer that خشية performs a related vigilance during reprieve. It may instead remain a broader awe not specifically equivalent to protective self-guarding.

changed_reading.before: The recipient fears the Merciful despite the divine name's reassuring force.
changed_reading.after: The recipient reveres the Merciful by treating present preservation as a temporary mercy and responding with vigilant self-guarding before unseen consequences arrive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unseen sphere of the focus ayah is not an unrecorded private zone. Secret and public are equally known, and at judgment ordinary self-report is sealed while embodied witnesses disclose acquisition. Hidden awe thus names integrity before inevitable disclosure rather than confidence that hidden conduct will remain hidden.

activation_trace.role: Concealment from human eyes anchors the private domain whose status the context revises.
A preventing seal disables controlled verbal presentation at the moment of disclosure.
Presence with direct witnessing makes the body disclose conduct that had belonged to private action.
Acquired action supplies the content of testimony and ties disclosure to deserved outcome.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower removes any epistemic gap on the divine side.
What is hidden in the interior names the concealed pole that remains fully known.
Open manifestation forms the contrasting public pole and shows that concealment changes no divine knowledge.

structural_cues: 36:76 balances what they conceal against what they announce under one divine knowledge claim.
36:65 stages later disclosure through hands and feet precisely when mouths can no longer manage the account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equal knowledge of secret and public plus embodied testimony; I infer a temporal movement from human-hidden conduct to unavoidable disclosure. An alternative is that بالغيب chiefly names an unseen divine object rather than private conduct, though the integrity reading remains available.

changed_reading.before: Fear in the unseen is devotion maintained without seeing or being seen.
changed_reading.after: Fear in the unseen is integrity practiced before disclosure: privacy from creatures is never absence from knowledge, record, or eventual witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly offers visible signs of what is not yet witnessed, then turns the Merciful's promise into a fulfilled reality before all are brought present. The focus command to give good news can therefore function as an advance sign: promised forgiveness and reward begin shaping conduct before their unseen arrival.

activation_trace.role: First appearances and advance signs anchor good news as more than neutral information.
An evident sign gives a present marker by which unseen revival can be anticipated.
A spoken promise opens expectation and supplies the future content announced in advance.
Fulfillment verifies the earlier promise and closes the interval opened by the announcement.
Being brought into presence converts what was absent and promised into witnessed actuality.

structural_cues: The surah moves from repeated signs in the present to recognition that the Merciful's promise was true.
Universal presence in 36:53 follows immediately after recognition of the fulfilled promise in 36:52.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus branch of first signs and the context's sign-promise-fulfillment sequence; I infer that good news mediates future reality into present conduct. It may also be read more simply as a joyful verbal report without sign-like force.

changed_reading.before: Good news reports a reward that will later be given.
changed_reading.after: Good news is the reward's first sign, allowing an unseen future to become behaviorally present before fulfillment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the botanical branch of كريم rather than its dominant social-honor branch. It remains anchored in أجر كريم and is reinforced by the surah's dead-earth, grain, fruit, garden, and peace sequence. Downstream prose should present it as an ecological coloring of reward, not as a replacement lexical definition of كريم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjective كريم can carry an image of good earth, vegetation, and rain, allowing the promised أجر to be imagined as fecund provision.

activation_trace.role: Recompense anchors the reading in the promised return rather than in an independent nature theme.
Good vegetation, fertile earth, and rain supply the unusual fecund quality assigned to the reward.
Earth revived by rain and vegetation gives the fecund reward image a surah-level mechanism.
A seed that grows and bears grain materializes life-producing generosity.
Fruit as realized benefit makes reward a matured yield rather than an abstract credit.
Delighted well-being carries the earthly growth sequence into the garden's experienced reward.
Freedom from harm gives the fecund provision a final condition of protected wholeness.

changed_reading.before: A noble reward is generous payment that confers honor.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its nobility is also fecund: a life-restoring yield that matures into fruit, delight, and protected wholeness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the technical fracture-setting branch of أجر and carries it into the late discussion of decayed bones. It remains anchored in the focus noun and gains a coherent repair mechanism from bone, decay, and renewed origination. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy for recompense and reconstitution, not claim that أجر in 36:11 directly means resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branch image of أجر as setting a broken bone allows the noble recompense to carry a secondary image of setting-right what has broken.

activation_trace.role: Setting a fracture, even after crooked healing, supplies the unusual reparative image while remaining rooted in the reward noun.
Matching action with its consequence preserves the recompense frame around the material repair analogy.
Solid bone supplies the material specifically vulnerable to fracture and later dissolution.
Decay and worn remains intensify repair beyond ordinary healing into reconstitution.
Bringing a thing into being supplies the restoring power that completes the setting-right mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The reward is a return paid for faithful response.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recompense also sets right and reconstitutes: the return includes repair of what mortality has broken and reduced to remains.

strongest_changes: The man of 36:20-27 enacts the focus recipient and reaches the exact forgiveness-and-honor outcome.
The denied human wage in 36:21 reverses into the divine noble wage promised to the follower.
The closing warning to whoever is alive reframes following remembrance and unseen awe as signs of living receptivity.
Recorded traces, bodily testimony, and knowledge of secret and public make hidden fidelity both trace-bearing and destined for disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed unusually exact recurrences of following, wage, forgiveness, and honor, while later trace, life, mercy, and disclosure sequences changed how the focus ayah's compact recipient profile functions.
remaining_uncertainties: بالغيب can foreground the unseen object of fear, private conduct outside human sight, or both.
The reciprocal trace model is coherent but may exceed the immediate lexical force of اتبع.
The ecological and fracture-repair activations should remain explicitly exploratory rather than enter an unqualified synthesis.
